headline: 📤 YOU SENT ABOUT THIRTY-FOUR EMAILS BY HAND IN A FIVE-MINUTE BURST AT 12:37 THIS AFTERNOON — warm check-ins, listing outreach and expired-seller notes — and your drafts folder went from forty to six. ⭐ THAT IS THE BIGGEST SEND OF THE WEEK AND IT IS REAL WORK. 🔴 BUT THE ONE DRAFT THAT HAS LED THREE STRAIGHT LETTERS IS NOW GONE WITHOUT BEING SENT: the receipt to Molly G. is no longer in Drafts, and her thread was re-enumerated cold at 5:5xp and still holds exactly one message — hers — at about 123 hours. 🆕 AND THE HOUSE UNDERNEATH IT MOVED AGAIN: a brand-new agent booked 225 Willow Point for Wednesday 9/2 at 6:00 PM, twelve minutes after this morning's tour cancelled. · DO: rewrite and send Molly four words — the draft is gone · DECIDE: 2127 Hwy 93 — open the price talk Monday, or hold? · WATCH: 195 Lake View still has no funding receipt, day 2 (re-verified 8/30 5:5xp).

notes: 🔴 ONE ROUTINE IS GENUINELY BLOCKED TONIGHT — the 4:47p deep sweep could not reach Brivity through the browser at all: the renderer wedged on the app and never finished loading, so Parts A, B, C, E and F did no work. ⭐ THE HONEST SPLIT: the Brivity API itself answered fine in under a second, so this is a browser problem, not an outage — and the seller-import tool is still simply absent, now eight consecutive runs. ✅ The lane skipped cleanly rather than inventing a workaround, and nothing was dropped.

✅ EVERYTHING ELSE RAN AND LOGGED — nineteen call-lane sweeps since 6:10 this morning, the milestone engine at 8:02, 11:03, 2:04 and 5:05, the deep sweep twice before the 4:47 block, the morning letter, the midday digest, the marketing blitz and the weekly CEO sweep at 5:1xp. ⭐ Nothing on this board is stale because a routine failed to fire.

📤 THE BIGGEST FLEET FACT TODAY IS NOT A ROUTINE, IT IS YOU — the drafts folder went 40 → 6 in a five-minute burst at 12:37p. ⚠️ TWO OF THOSE SENDS HARD-BOUNCED ON DELIVERY, so two names on that list were never actually reached and neither knows it. ⭐ AND ONE DRAFT LEFT THE FOLDER WITHOUT BEING SENT — the Molly G. receipt. This desk will not guess whether that was deliberate; it only reports that the thread is still unanswered and the written reply no longer exists.
